goal: Establish persistence and test package initialization markers by creating empty module marker files persistence/__init__.py and tests/card_1_1/__init__.py under D:\__CoChem to define explicit Python package boundaries in accordance with AC-20 (Scope Purity Gate) with zero extraneous code or dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The files persistence/__init__.py and tests/card_1_1/__init__.py exist as regular files on disk with exactly 0 bytes (empty module markers).
Both persistence and tests.card_1_1 can be successfully imported as valid Python packages without ImportError or SyntaxError.

Under git status --porcelain, modified or untracked files are strictly confined to the closed 16-file scope (specifically persistence/__init__.py, tests/card_1_1/__init__.py, and test-runner artifacts), and __agentic/v2/brief_card_1_1.md exhibits zero diff.

test_cases.name: test_package_init_markers_exist_and_empty
test_cases.asserts: Asserts that persistence/__init__.py and tests/card_1_1/__init__.py exist on the filesystem as regular files and that their file sizes are exactly 0 bytes.

test_cases.name: test_package_init_markers_importable
test_cases.asserts: Asserts that importlib.import_module('persistence') and importlib.import_module('tests.card_1_1') execute successfully and resolve to package namespaces.

test_cases.name: test_ac20_scope_purity
test_cases.asserts: Asserts that git status --porcelain contains only paths from the closed 16-file list (persistence/__init__.py and tests/card_1_1/__init__.py), and that __agentic/v2/brief_card_1_1.md has zero git diff.

out_of_scope: Adding code, functions, classes, docstrings, or external imports to __init__.py files
risks: Accidentally populating __init__.py with placeholder logic, stubs, or imports violating zero-mock or purity constraints
Parent directory persistence/ or tests/card_1_1/ not existing prior to file creation
Untracked file contamination outside the closed 16-file scope violating AC-20
